notes: 0x43f80 (16 B, unnamed): MMAllocPtr wrapper. C-unreachable (tail-jmp arg pass-through with ecx=arg2 + edx=0 register-pair seeding), so naked asm: xor edx,edx / mov ecx,[esp+8] / jmp mmAllocPtr. CL emits 33 d2 8b 4c 24 08 e9 rel32 = FA bytes verbatim. Map TO @MMAllocPtr@8 is a defined FA symbol; chunk is unnamed so the fitted obj must re-define the stub's $FA$_t_443f80 anchor via alias.

0x32210 (32 B, unnamed): 16-bit seed scramble — wall-class (16-bit register-ABI: eax keeps Rand's high word while only ax/sub ax,si changes). Naked asm: push esi / imul cx,cx,0B6h / mov si,cx / lea ecx,[esi*2] / call Rand2 / sub ax,si / pop esi / ret. NOTE dis.py ELIDES the 7-byte 8d0c7500000000 lea ecx,[esi*2] between mov si,cx and call — always cross-check dis.py against raw FA bytes. MASM picked FA's exact encodings everywhere (66 69 imm16 form for imul, 66 8b f1, 66 2b c6). @Rand@4 maps from CL-level Rand2.

0x7c2e0 (32 B, unnamed): __fastcall skip-space-or-tab, pure C, byte-exact first try of THIS shape. Recipe: single return of p forced via break (for(;;){ c=*p; if(!c) return 0; if(c==' '||c=='\t') break; ++p; } return p;) — early return of p makes CL stage eax=p at loop head (wrong shape); one break-exit keeps the load c=*p in AL each iteration with test/cmp al. FPO locals=0, char c lives in al. Plain 'if (*p==...)' reloads give cmp byte[ecx],0 head instead.

provenance: patch 11 (pop2p, 0xd70a0): toolchain-diff — the __int64 pop: CL 4.2 computes old=ptr-8 (sub ecx,8) BEFORE the two loads and addresses them [ecx]/[ecx+4]; FA loads [ecx-8]/[ecx-4] (disp-folded off the incremented pointer) and issues the now-dead sub ecx,8 afterwards. Rewrote the 9-byte load/return tail (83 e9 08 8b 01 8b 51 04 c3 -> 8b 41 f8 8b 51 fc 83 e9 08 c3); FA chunk is the +8 twin of siblings at 0xd7090 (long pop) and 0xd70c0 (short pop).
notes: 0xd70a0 (21 B, unnamed): __int64 pop-and-advance. Base C (long p; p=(long)*pp+8; *pp=p; v=*(__int64*)(p-8); return v;) matches all but the load/sub ordering; patch fixes the tail. No relocs in the patched span. All four C spellings tried converge to CL's sub-first form, so C alone cannot reproduce the byte order.

0x8ca30 _OBJSayProc (80 B): pure C twin of _SAYDefaultSayProc (w27b, 0x8b520) plus ONE spelling delta: the $-test is switch((unsigned char)s[0xa]) case '$' — the single-case switch on an unsigned char cast gives FA's xor eax,eax / mov al,[esi+0xa] / cmp eax,0x24 form (wave-16 uchar-dispatcher idiom). Plain if (s[0xa]=='$') gives cmp al,0x24 (the twin's shape); a (unsigned char*)s cast gives cmp al too, and a char switch gives movsx. #pragma function(strlen) still required (intrinsic otherwise). Same SAYSetupFq/SAYSetVarq/SAYFinalq maps as w27b.

0xbe2f0 _PROJProc (64 B): pure C function-pointer switch! Recipe: void *PROJProc(unsigned char t) { switch (t) { case 1..4: return (void *)handler; } return (void *)0; } — with cases in FA stub order (1=PROJDispq dispatcher $FA$_t_4be330, 2=?PROJMoveProc@@YAXD@Z, 3=?PROJEventProc@@YADFJ@Z, 4=?PROJDamageProc@@YAXPAUHIT_OBJ_DATA@@@Z). CL 4.2 emits the whole FA shape natively: xor eax,eax / mov al,[esp+4] / dec / cmp eax,3 / ja default / ff 24 85 table / 4x stub 'mov eax,imm; ret' + ff/jmp table with 4 DIR32 entries ($L94-97 internal stub labels — NO patches needed; table[0] resolves to stub0 inside the chunk, stub imms are the map TOs above, all verified against FA imm dwords 0x4be330/0x4bd550/0x4be060/0x4bdc10). unsigned char param (not char) is required to get the xor/mov-al zero-extend instead of movsx or a plain 32-bit param load. An earlier verified-against-mask patch that retargeted table[0] to $FA$_t_4be330 was WRONG (misread of stub0's imm as a table entry) and is not needed.
